script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

OUT="$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/artifacts"
WORK="$SUPRALINUX_WORKSPACE_ROOT/review-scan"
REPO="$WORK/repo"
mkdir -p "$OUT" "$WORK"

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl dpkg-dev git gpgv python3 tar xz-utils

git init -q "$REPO"
git -C "$REPO" remote add origin https://github.com/SupraLINUX/SupraLINUX.git
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$SUPRALINUX_SOURCE_COMMIT"
git -C "$REPO" checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
test "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SUPRALINUX_SOURCE_COMMIT"

python3 - "$REPO" "$WORK/pending.tsv" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
level = json.loads((root/"manifests/kde-plasma-level0.json").read_text())
with Path(sys.argv[2]).open("w") as f:
    for node in level["selected_nodes"]:
        rec = level["nodes"][node]
        if rec["state"] != "packaging-preparation-pending":
            continue
        ref = rec["packaging_reference"]["source_package"]
        refver = rec["ubuntu_reference_version"]
        print(node, ref, refver, rec["candidate_package_version"],
              rec["upstream_source_url"], rec["upstream_source_sha256"],
              sep="\t", file=f)
PY

RESULTS="$OUT/results.tsv"
: > "$RESULTS"

while IFS=$'\t' read -r node src refver candidate url expected_sha; do
    echo "=== $node / $src $refver ==="
    NODE_WORK="$WORK/$node"
    NODE_OUT="$OUT/$node"
    rm -rf "$NODE_WORK"
    mkdir -p "$NODE_WORK" "$NODE_OUT"

    (
        cd "$NODE_WORK"
        apt-get source --download-only "$src=$refver"
        dscs=( *.dsc )
        test "${#dscs[@]}" -eq 1
        dpkg-source -x "${dscs[0]}" extracted >/dev/null
    )

    test -f "$NODE_WORK/extracted/debian/control"
    test -f "$NODE_WORK/extracted/debian/rules"
    test -f "$NODE_WORK/extracted/debian/changelog"

    tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner         -cJf "$NODE_OUT/ubuntu-debian-tree.tar.xz"         -C "$NODE_WORK/extracted" debian

    curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180         --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "$NODE_WORK/upstream.tar.xz" "$url"
    actual_sha="$(sha256sum "$NODE_WORK/upstream.tar.xz" | awk '{print $1}')"
    test "$actual_sha" = "$expected_sha"

    mkdir -p "$NODE_WORK/upstream"
    tar -xf "$NODE_WORK/upstream.tar.xz" -C "$NODE_WORK/upstream" --strip-components=1

    (
        cd "$NODE_WORK/upstream"
        find . -type f \(             -name 'CMakeLists.txt' -o             -name '*.cmake' -o             -path './autotests/*' -o             -path './tests/*'         \) -print0 | sort -z |         tar --null -T - --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner             -cJf "$NODE_OUT/upstream-build-test-files.tar.xz"
    )

    python3 - "$node" "$src" "$refver" "$candidate" "$expected_sha"         "$NODE_WORK/extracted/debian" "$NODE_WORK/upstream" "$NODE_OUT/summary.json" <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
node, source, refver, candidate, upstream_sha = sys.argv[1:6]
debian = Path(sys.argv[6])
upstream = Path(sys.argv[7])
out = Path(sys.argv[8])

control = (debian/"control").read_text(errors="replace")
rules = (debian/"rules").read_text(errors="replace")
changelog = (debian/"changelog").read_text(errors="replace")

build_depends = ""
m = re.search(r"(?ms)^Build-Depends:\s*(.*?)(?=\n\S|\Z)", control)
if m:
    build_depends = " ".join(line.strip() for line in m.group(1).splitlines())

binaries = re.findall(r"(?m)^Package:\s*(\S+)", control)
patches = sorted(str(p.relative_to(debian)) for p in (debian/"patches").glob("*")
                 if p.is_file() and p.name != "series") if (debian/"patches").is_dir() else []
upstream_tests = sorted(str(p.relative_to(upstream)) for p in upstream.rglob("*")
                        if p.is_file() and ("test" in p.name.lower() or "autotest" in str(p).lower()))
cmake_files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(upstream)) for p in upstream.rglob("CMakeLists.txt"))

payload = {
    "schema": 1,
    "node": node,
    "source_package": source,
    "ubuntu_reference_version": refver,
    "candidate_package_version": candidate,
    "upstream_sha256": upstream_sha,
    "binary_packages": binaries,
    "build_depends": build_depends,
    "ubuntu_patch_files": patches,
    "ubuntu_rules": rules,
    "ubuntu_changelog_head": "\n".join(changelog.splitlines()[:12]),
    "ubuntu_autopkgtest_control_present": (debian/"tests/control").is_file(),
    "upstream_cmake_file_count": len(cmake_files),
    "upstream_test_like_file_count": len(upstream_tests),
    "upstream_test_like_sample": upstream_tests[:40],
    "package_execution_started": False,
    "consumes_package_attempt": False,
}
out.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

    printf '%s\tPASS\t%s\t%s\n' "$node"         "$(sha256sum "$NODE_OUT/ubuntu-debian-tree.tar.xz" | awk '{print $1}')"         "$(sha256sum "$NODE_OUT/upstream-build-test-files.tar.xz" | awk '{print $1}')"         >> "$RESULTS"

    rm -rf "$NODE_WORK"
done < "$WORK/pending.tsv"

python3 - "$SUPRALINUX_SOURCE_COMMIT" "$OUT" "$RESULTS" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
source_commit = sys.argv[1]
out = Path(sys.argv[2])
rows = []
for line in Path(sys.argv[3]).read_text().splitlines():
    node,state,ubuntu_sha,upstream_sha = line.split("\t")
    rows.append({
        "node":node,
        "state":state,
        "ubuntu_debian_tree_sha256":ubuntu_sha,
        "upstream_build_test_files_sha256":upstream_sha,
    })
result = {
    "schema":1,
    "state":"PASS" if rows else "INFRA_INVALID",
    "scope":"plasma-level0-remaining-packaging-review-scan",
    "source_commit":source_commit,
    "node_count":len(rows),
    "nodes":rows,
    "package_execution_started":False,
    "consumes_package_attempt":False,
    "canonical_package_state_effect":"none",
}
(out/"result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
PY

rm -rf "$WORK"
echo "Remaining Plasma Level 0 packaging review scan: PASS"
